也可以直接粘贴作品或作者主页链接: Or paste a public work or author profile URL
从对标资料到原创文章: From reference material to an original article
使用所选作品的内容重新构建文章，避免逐句改写。: Build an original structure from the selected references; avoid sentence by sentence rewriting.
例如：Python自动化、AI办公效率: For example: Python automation, AI productivity
例如：清晰教程、短句经验分享: For example: clear tutorials, concise practical notes
修改影响下次生成，已有草稿和来源样本保持可追溯。: Changes apply to future generation. Existing drafts and source samples remain traceable.
先在AI服务页接入自己的API: Configure your API in AI services first
先在对标研究台按数据筛选作者主页，再选择同一作者的3至10件作品并采集正文。: Filter author profiles in Benchmarks, then select 3 to 10 works from one author and collect their content.
先看作品表现，再决定研究谁。链接、指标、正文和采集时间都保留。: Compare public performance before choosing an author. Keep URLs, metrics, content and collection times.
内置二创提示词已保存，下次生成可以继续使用: Default rewriting prompt saved for future generation
列表摘要，需打开详情采集正文: Search summary only; open the detail page to collect content
剪贴板写入失败，请保存或导出文件: Clipboard failed. Save or export the content.
在原有AI服务页填写自己的API地址、模型和密钥。密钥只保存到系统凭据库。: Enter your API URL, model and key in AI services. Keys are stored only in the system credential vault.
填写真实经历、步骤、案例、读者问题或产品信息；没有提供的个人经验不会编造。: Add real experience, steps, cases, reader questions or product facts. Personal experience will not be invented.
完成第一次标题与正文生成后，草稿会出现在这里。: Your first generated title and body will appear here.
所选作品需要已采集正文，且不能超过10件。请回到研究台打开详情采集。: Select up to 10 references with collected content. Collect their details in Benchmarks first.
把选题写成一篇好笔记: Turn a topic into a useful note
操作未完成，请检查当前配置后重试: The action did not complete. Check your configuration and retry.
明确一个读者问题或使用场景: Choose a reader question or practical scenario
未提供的指标不推算；设置最低值时会排除缺失项。: Missing metrics are not estimated. Minimum filters exclude missing values.
查看和二次修改内置二创提示词: View and edit the rewriting prompt
查看和修改内置风格分析提示词: View and edit the style analysis prompt
标题与正文已生成并保存: Titles and body generated and saved
正文以平台当前公开可见部分为准；页面折叠或只显示预览时，请展开后重新采集。: Collected content comes from the publicly visible page. Expand collapsed content or previews before collecting again.
每次可以一键切换已保存的对标风格。: Switch between saved styles for each draft.
每次成功生成都会保存。标题、正文、参考作品、风格和模型记录都可以找回。: Every successful generation is saved with title, content, references, style and model record.
生成后这里会出现多个二次标题、完整正文和关键词。可以编辑、复制、导出，并在草稿记: Generated titles, complete content and tags will appear here. Edit, copy, export or reopen them in Drafts.
用同一主页的多篇作品提炼写法。保存多个风格，每次写作都可以切换。: Analyze multiple works from one profile. Save several styles and switch them while writing.
自然清晰，不套用风格: Clear and natural, without a saved style
让真实资料变成自己的表达: Turn real references into your own writing
调用你选择的文本模型。失败不会自动重复付费请求；生成内容需要你核对事实后使用。: Uses your selected text model. Failed requests are not automatically repeated. Check facts before using generated content.
输入关键词或公开链接，采集完成后在这里比较作品表现。: Enter a keyword or public URL, then compare collected works here.
选择参考和风格，补充自己的材料。二次标题与正文一起生成，提示词可以随时修改。: Choose references and style, then add your own facts. Generate titles and content together, with editable prompts.
采集同一主页的真实作品，分析后将写作规律保存在这里。: Collect real works from one profile and save their writing patterns here after analysis.
需要同一主页3至10件作品，且每件都已采集正文。: Select 3 to 10 works from one profile, each with collected content.
首次采集会打开可见窗口，平台需要登录时请在该窗口登录。打开详情后可补充正文与收藏: Collection opens a visible window. Sign in there if required. Open detail pages to collect content and additional public metrics.
指标来自各次公开页面采集；本次未读到的指标保留已有数值。: Metrics come from public page collections. Previously collected values are retained when a later page does not provide them.
